description: Referable dams register is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Local Government, Water and Volunteers. List of dams deemed as referable based on a failure impact assessment (FIA) which states that the dam has or will have a Category 1 or Category 2 failure impact rating. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Local Government, Water and Volunteers. Its tags are government, reporting, water. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLS. The portal shows 2026-07-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
